ex.s: 我今日唔舒服，唔返工喇。
ex.r: ngo5 gam1 jat6 m4 syu1 fuk6 m4 faan1 gung1 laa3
ex.en: I'm not feeling well today, so I won't go to work.

ex.r: nei5 bin1 dou6 m4 syu1 fuk6 aa3
co5 syun4 co5 dou3 hou2 m4 syu1 fuk6
ex.en: The boat ride made me feel really unwell.

ex.r: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 sau2 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3

ex.s: 「唔該晒你送我返屋企。」「唔使客氣。」
ex.r: m4 goi1 saai3 nei5 sung3 ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3
ex.en: "Thanks for taking me home." "Don't mention it."

ex.s: 「唔該你幫我拎行李。」「唔使客氣。」
ex.r: m4 goi1 nei5 bong1 ngo5 ling1 hang4 lei5 m4 sai2 haak3 hei3
ex.en: "Thanks for helping me with my luggage." "You're welcome."

ex.s: 我要去開會喇，下次再傾。
ex.r: ngo5 jiu3 heoi3 hoi1 wui2 laa3 haa6 ci3 zoi3 king1
ex.en: I've got to go to a meeting — let's talk again next time.

ex.s: 今日好開心，下次再傾啦。
ex.r: gam1 jat6 hou2 hoi1 sam1 haa6 ci3 zoi3 king1 laa1
ex.en: Today was great — let's talk again next time.

ex.s: 我部手機就快冇電喇，下次再傾。
ex.r: ngo5 bou6 sau2 gei1 zau6 faai3 mou5 din6 laa3 haa6 ci3 zoi3 king1
ex.en: My phone's about to die — let's talk again next time.

notes: Jyutping all correct (dictionary CHECKs are valid colloquial readings). Fixed: 唔使客氣 ex used unglossed 'don't be shy' sense; ungrammatical 就冇電 without 快/喇; awkward English gloss.
